name: home-finder
description: Home Finder - automatsko praćenje oglasa za placeve, kuće i vikendice na Fruškoj gori

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:setup -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
